_meta.source: CDS C9 (GPA distribution) + C21 (ED/EA) via LLM

schools.notes: University of Pittsburgh does not report GPA distribution data (all GPA percentages are 0.00%) and does not offer Early Decision or Early Action plans (responses for ED and EA are 'N').
C9 GPA distribution not reported (all zero percents); Early Decision plan offered with 1139 applications and 755 admits; no Early Action offered.
C9 GPA distribution table reported all zeroes; early decision plan reported with 726 applications and 579 admits; early action plan offered but no application/admit numbers provided.

University of Connecticut does not report a detailed high school GPA distribution in section C9; percent values are all 0%. Early Decision is offered with closing date November 1 and notification mid December, but counts of ED applications and admits are not provided. No Early Action plan is offered.

The CDS does not provide a high school GPA distribution (C11 is blank) and Rutgers University-New Brunswick does not offer Early Decision plans (C21 ED plan is marked No). There is an Early Action plan with closing date 11/1 and notification date 1/31, but no numbers for applications or admits are given.
